plant.description: frozen MuJoCo 6-DoF UAV with 5-link suspended chain and cutter

task_output.orientation: equilibrium cutter orientation; arbitrary 3-D orientation is out of scope

tasks.name: CALM_3D_SETPOINT
tasks.objective: reach nearby 3-D cutter-tip target and satisfy terminal acquisition

tasks.name: WIND_3D_SETPOINT
tasks.objective: reach the same type of nearby 3-D target under causal wind disturbance

tasks.name: RAMP_WIND_EQUILIBRIUM_HOLD
tasks.objective: hold equilibrium cutter position and orientation

nearby_target_policy: fixed nearby terminal setpoints defined in the development/holdout split; no arbitrary-global-reachability claim
